description: Source code implementing VP9 scalable video coding layers, including layer configuration, reference frame management, and encoding update logic for VP9 SVC in Chromium's media GPU module.

classes.name: VP9SVCLayers
classes.description: Class managing VP9 SVC layer configurations, reference frame patterns, and encoding updates.

classes.name: VP9SVCLayers::FrameConfig
classes.description: Structure representing configuration for a VP9 SVC frame, including reference and update frame indices.

methods.name: GetSVCName
methods.description: Returns a string name for the SVC configuration based on active layers and temporal layers.

methods.name: VP9SVCLayers::VP9SVCLayers
methods.description: Constructor initializing VP9 SVC layers with spatial layer configurations.

methods.name: UpdateEncodeJob
methods.description: Determines if a new encode job should be started based on key frame requests and frame count.

methods.name: MaybeUpdateActiveLayer
methods.description: Attempts to update active spatial and temporal layers based on bitrate allocation and layer configurations.

methods.name: FillUsedRefFramesAndMetadata
methods.description: Fills reference frame flags and metadata for a VP9 picture based on current layer configuration.

methods.name: FillVp9MetadataForEncoding
methods.description: Populates VP9 metadata for encoding, including reference frames, layer indices, and flags.

methods.name: UpdateRefFramesPatternIndex
methods.description: Updates pattern indices for reference frames to assist in P-diff calculations.
